# sim/assets — generated, checked-in data

**`swiss-dem-90m.bin`** — generated by `sim/tools/bake_swiss_dem.py` against a LOCAL `fb-tiles`
(default `http://localhost:8081`); NOT a build dependency, run manually only when the bbox/resolution
changes. DO NOT hand-edit.

- Coverage: 5.96–10.49°E / 45.82–47.81°N (Switzerland + a margin), 90 m raster, 3836x2462 int16 samples
  (little-endian), row 0 = south, col 0 = west. Outside the box: 0 m. Inner ~15 km of every edge
  smoothsteps down to 0 m (no hard cliff at the bbox border).
- Source: fb-tiles' `/t/terrain/<z>/<x>/<y>` Terrarium DEM tiles (zoom 11, ~52-53 m/px over this bbox),
  bilinearly resampled onto the 90 m output grid — verified against `/elev` at multiple points before
  baking (see the flightbox lib/client-split task report for the comparison table).
- Consumer: `sim/src/core/FBBakedDemElevation.h/.cpp` (byte layout documented in the .cpp banner).
- Regenerate: `python3 tools/bake_swiss_dem.py --base http://localhost:8081 --out assets/swiss-dem-90m.bin`
  (needs Pillow + numpy; takes ~1 min cold against a local fb-tiles, ~2 s once fb-tiles' own disk cache
  is warm).
